final: WITH s1 AS (SELECT rm.ordervault AS ref, o.timespan AS tif, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM riskandmargin rm JOIN orders o ON o.recordvault = rm.ordervault GROUP BY rm.ordervault, o.timespan), s2 AS (SELECT tif, SUM(cnt) AS total FROM s1 GROUP BY tif), s3 AS (SELECT SUM(total) AS grand FROM s2), s4 AS (SELECT s2.tif AS tif, s2.total AS total, CAST(s2.total AS REAL) / s3.grand AS ratio FROM s2 JOIN s3 ON s3.grand IS NOT NULL), s5 AS (SELECT AVG(ratio) AS avg_ratio FROM s4) SELECT s4.tif, s4.total, s4.ratio, s4.ratio - s5.avg_ratio AS ratio_minus_avg FROM s4 JOIN s5 ON s5.avg_ratio IS NOT NULL ORDER BY s4.tif
